content.title: Environment-Interrupted Duel | Shared Disruption and Same-Axis Resumption
content.summary: Two adult airship rivals resume a spear-and-staff duel after one pressure vent knocks both down. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: Two clearly adult original opponents, one fixed conflict axis and three environmental anchors establish the duel. + Every attack, evade and block remains readable while environmental force progressively changes balance. + One major external event interrupts both opponents simultaneously and preserves the same geography. + Both adults recover from visible post-interruption positions before any renewed attack begins. + The terminal exchange returns to the original axis and remains unresolved without inventing a winner.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place two clearly adult original rivals on a rain-darkened airship maintenance bridge: a bronze-armored engineer with a short spear faces a slate-coated navigator with a hooked staff. Increase crosswind and bridge roll so each next action requires visible foot correction and hand contact with the same rail. They stand from those exact positions, re-form the original center line and complete one renewed weapon exchange before holding unresolved under the exact title "BRIDGE WEATHER".
required_anchors: Two clearly adult original opponents, one fixed conflict axis and three environmental anchors establish the duel.
Every attack, evade and block remains readable while environmental force progressively changes balance.
Both adults recover from visible post-interruption positions before any renewed attack begins.
The terminal exchange returns to the original axis and remains unresolved without inventing a winner.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Two adult airship rivals resume a spear-and-staff duel after one pressure vent knocks both down. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 先在同一危险环境中建立两名成年对手和可读攻防轴，让风、雨和载体摇摆逐步改变脚步；一次强烈环境事件必须同时打断双方，双方恢复站位后沿原轴继续交锋。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: Two clearly adult original opponents, one fixed conflict axis and three environmental anchors establish the duel.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "Two clearly adult original opponents, one fixed conflict axis and three environmental anchors establish the duel."

invariants.rule: Every attack, evade and block remains readable while environmental force progressively changes balance.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Every attack, evade and block remains readable while environmental force progressively changes balance."

invariants.rule: One major external event interrupts both opponents simultaneously and preserves the same geography.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "One major external event interrupts both opponents simultaneously and preserves the same geography."

invariants.rule: Both adults recover from visible post-interruption positions before any renewed attack begins.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Both adults recover from visible post-interruption positions before any renewed attack begins."

invariants.rule: The terminal exchange returns to the original axis and remains unresolved without inventing a winner.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal exchange returns to the original axis and remains unresolved without inventing a winner."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
